svg.title: Cross-Team Knowledge Relay Low-Level Design Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for Cross-Team Knowledge Relay.
svg.text: Detailed request, data, graph, scoring, state, and error-handling view for the bounty matching backend.
• request logs, queue depth, graph latency,

• Input: POST /api/v1/bounties with title, description, poster_team, skills[], bounty_amount, ttl_seconds. Output: 202 Accepted with bounty{id,status,expiresAt,matchedExperts[]}. Error paths: 400 invalid payload/missing fields, 405
method not allowed, circuit-breaker fallback for graph latency.
